issues.issue: Admissibility of four new documents: two affidavits, airport information and NDP item 10.2
issues.applicant_position: Submits four documents as new evidence and asks for a hearing before the RAD.
issues.result_text: None of the four documents is admitted; no hearing can be held under s.110(6) IRPA.

issues.issue: Whether the RPD erred on the passport, APRDH letter, militia violence evidence and travel itinerary
issues.applicant_position: RPD ignored his passport, wrongly inferred credibility from the missing APRDH letter, and focused on peripheral travel issues.
issues.result_text: RPD erred on passport, APRDH letter, violence evidence and itinerary focus; these errors are determinative.

issues.issue: Whether the RPD hearing left central credibility questions unasked
issues.result_text: Central credibility questions were not asked at the RPD hearing; the matter goes back for redetermination.
